zelda1.title: The Legend of Zelda
zelda1.description: Link's original quest to rescue Princess Zelda and recover the Triforce of Wisdom from Ganon.

entries.title: NES Original
entries.version_desc: The original 1986 NES release. Classic gameplay without any modifications.

entries.title: NES Redux
entries.version_desc: Quality-of-life improvements: in-game maps, upgraded inventory UI and various bug fixes, preserving the original feel.

entries.title: BS Satellaview
entries.version_desc: Satellaview remake with enhanced SNES graphics, redesigned overworld layouts and newly composed music.

zelda2.title: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link
zelda2.description: Action RPG sequel. Link must awaken Princess Zelda and destroy Ganon's shadow across Hyrule.

entries.title: NES Original
entries.version_desc: The original 1987 NES side-scrolling RPG. Notoriously challenging difficulty.

entries.title: NES Redux
entries.version_desc: Rebalanced difficulty curve, improved controls and UI fixes for a more approachable experience.

zelda3.title: A Link to the Past
zelda3.description: Link travels between the Light World and Dark World to defeat Agahnim and save Hyrule from Ganon.

entries.title: SNES Original
entries.version_desc: The original 1991 SNES release. Widely considered one of the greatest games ever made.

entries.title: ALTTP Redux
entries.version_desc: Restoration hack that re-introduces content cut from the Japanese original, alongside quality-of-life improvements and a refined translation.

bszelda_ast.title: Ancient Stone Tablets
bszelda_ast.description: Satellaview broadcast Zelda across 4 weeks. Complete both dungeons each week to unlock the next.

zelda5.title: Link's Awakening
zelda5.description: Shipwrecked on Koholint Island, Link must awaken the Wind Fish to escape and return home.

entries.title: GBC Original
entries.version_desc: The original Game Boy Color release of Link's island adventure.

entries.title: Redux
entries.version_desc: Enhanced color palette, rebalanced gameplay, smoother controls and various quality-of-life improvements.

zelda6.title: Oracle of Seasons
zelda6.description: Link must restore the seasons in Holodrum by defeating Onox and rescuing the Oracle of Seasons, Din.

entries.title: GBC Original
entries.version_desc: Original GBC release. Manipulate the seasons to solve puzzles and navigate the world.

zelda7.title: Oracle of Ages
zelda7.description: Link travels through time in Labrynna to rescue Nayru, the Oracle of Ages, from Veran's control.

entries.title: GBC Original
entries.version_desc: Original GBC release. Travel between past and present to unravel Veran's scheme.

zelda8.title: The Minish Cap
zelda8.description: Link shrinks down to Minish size to forge the Four Sword and stop the sorcerer Vaati from covering Hyrule in darkness.

entries.title: GBA Original
entries.version_desc: Original GBA release. A unique adventure where Link can shrink to explore a hidden world.

zelda_oot.title: Ocarina of Time
zelda_oot.description: Link travels through time to stop Ganondorf from claiming the Triforce and conquering Hyrule.

entries.title: N64 Original
entries.version_desc: The original 1998 N64 release. A masterpiece that defined 3D action-adventure.

entries.title: Redux
entries.version_desc: Hack with quality-of-life improvements, refined controls and restored content.

entries.title: Spaceworld '97 Beta
entries.version_desc: A recreation of the demo shown at Nintendo Space World 1997: beta areas, dialogue and textures carefully restored by /Zel/.

entries.title: Ship of Harkinian
entries.version_desc: Native recompilation with widescreen, 60fps and quality-of-life improvements. Runs outside the launcher.

zelda_mm.title: Majora's Mask
zelda_mm.description: Trapped in Termina, Link has only three days to stop the moon from crashing into the world.

entries.title: N64 Original
entries.version_desc: The original 2000 N64 release, a direct sequel to Ocarina of Time built around the three-day system.

entries.title: Redux
entries.version_desc: Hack with quality-of-life improvements and gameplay tweaks.

zelda_foe.title: Link: The Faces of Evil
zelda_foe.description: One of the infamous Zelda games for the Philips CD-i. Link sets out to free the island of Koridai from Ganon. Heads-up: it boots to a light-blue screen and takes around 30 seconds to start.

entries.title: CD-i Original
entries.version_desc: The notorious 1993 CD-i title, famous for its animated cutscenes. Heads-up: it boots to a light-blue screen and takes around 30 seconds to start.

zelda_wog.title: Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon
zelda_wog.description: A CD-i game starring Zelda, who travels to the land of Gamelon to rescue Link and the King. Heads-up: it boots to a light-blue screen and takes around 30 seconds to start.

entries.title: CD-i Original
entries.version_desc: A 1993 CD-i title where Zelda is the playable protagonist. Heads-up: it boots to a light-blue screen and takes around 30 seconds to start.

zelda_adv.title: Zelda's Adventure
zelda_adv.description: The third and most distinct CD-i Zelda game: an isometric top-down action-adventure where Princess Zelda sets out to rescue Link. Available as the CD-i original and a Game Boy Color fan remake.

entries.title: CD-i Original
entries.version_desc: The 1994 Philips CD-i original. Unlike the other CD-i Zeldas, a live-action-flavored isometric adventure starring Zelda as the hero. Heads-up: it boots to a light-blue screen and takes around 30 seconds to start.

entries.title: GBC Fan Remake
entries.version_desc: Fan-made Game Boy Color demake that reimagines the CD-i original in classic top-down GBC style.
